Discover more Discover all destinations English English 简体中文 Close Arrow left Back Global menu Brand home English English 简体中文 Shanghai, China Amanyangyun An all-season escape on Shanghai’s vibrant fringe, Amanyangyun promises outdoor adventure, wellness exploration and cultural immersion in spectacular natural surroundings. On 140 pristine hectares, cycle through giant camphor trees and storied, stone villas to the tea house or art gallery. Drift over forest-embraced lakes and picnic in tranquil glades. Dine at five signature restaurants and delve deeper into holistic wellbeing at the comprehensive Aman Spa. At the resort's heart lies Nan Shufang, dedicated to revealing China’s rich heritage. Plan your stay Both guests and non-residents are invited to dine in Amanyangyun's restaurants and visit the Aman Spa . To make a reservation, please contact Amanyangyun's reservations team here . Explore accommodation A verdant sanctuary sensitively restored to reflect its magnificent natural setting, just 24 Suites and 11 Antique Villas with private tranquil courtyards create Amanyangyun’s intimate village feel. Accommodation Suites & Pavilions Contemporary Suites and Pavilions are light-filled havens reflecting their serene woodland setting. Accommodation Antique Villas Redolent of the past, Antique Villas offer four bedrooms arranged around courtyards and private pools. View all accommodation Book now Discover experiences wellness & Fitness An immersive wellness destination Amanyangyun Spa & Wellness Centre stands as one of Shanghai's premier destinations for rejuvenation and relaxation. Discover more FARM-TO-TABLE DINING Take an organic garden tour Join chefs for a guided tour of Amanyangyun's 200 square-metre organic garden, which supplies the kitchens with seasonal produce. Discover more dining experience Savour Afternoon Tea on The Lake Chinese Afternoon Tea on The Lake is the perfect way to unwind amidst Amanyangyun’s beautiful surroundings. Make an enquiry Cultural Discovery Centre Explore family activities A convivial meeting ground for little ones, Amanyangyun’s Children's Discovery Centre offers a host of experiences. Discover more dining experience Indulge in Arva's Italian cuisine A lakeside Italian restaurant with a warm, convivial atmosphere, Arva draws inspiration from Italy’s farm-to-table culinary traditions. Discover more sustainability initiative King Camphor Tree Seedlings Program In homage to its central 80-tonne King Camphor Tree, Amanyangyun has introduced a King Camphor Tree Seedlings Program.
